assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaires do not contain a separate module dedicated to domestic or care work. Domestic tasks and care work are only referenced in isolated items within Section D (questions d.16 and d.17 regarding paid domestic work or unpaid domestic help received by the household) and Section F (question f.1 explicitly excluding household chores from work, and question f.82 listing performing household chores as an activity status). A separate domestic or care work module containing more than two questions is not mentioned in the instrument.
